The practical message still comes through clearly: improve the structure of positives before relying on next-token scale to produce alignment.86:T420,Its impact is mainly conceptual rather than recipe-level. The paper provides a fairly complete derivation path from constrained entropy minimization to attention, instead of treating attention as an empirical neural module that happened to work. More specifically, it interprets softmax choice, query-key interactions, and value aggregation as consequences of a Gibbs-tilted posterior over random measures. This matters in three ways. First, attention is framed as the minimal departure from an unstructured prior needed to encode sentence-level relational statistics. Second, the query-key matrix can be read as a natural parameter, or Lagrange-multiplier object, associated with those statistics, which is useful when thinking about what training is actually fitting. Third, the paper places Transformers inside a measure-valued statistical language model, making contact with score-based and flow-style viewpoints. For pretraining researchers, this is not a plug-in method paper; it is a theory paper that sharpens the modeling picture around attention.87:Ta2c,The technical story has three layers.

First is the representation layer. The paper starts from two empirical observations: normalized token states are approximately constrained to a sphere, and self-attention without positional information is permutation-equivariant over tokens. This motivates representing a sentence of length n as an empirical measure μ_n = (1/n)∑δ_{x_i} on S^d. A language is then a distribution over such measures, P* ∈ P(P(S^d)).

Second is the maximum-entropy posterior. The null model N samples a sentence length and then draws tokens i.i.d. uniformly on the sphere. Given a vector of sentence-level statistics Φ, the posterior is defined as the KL projection of N onto the set of laws matching the observed expectation of Φ. Under standard regularity conditions, the solution is an exponential-family or Gibbs tilt, P^Φ ∝ exp(<V^Φ, Φ>) N. The crucial point is not the existence of the Gibbs form itself, but that the predictive law of the last token can be expressed through a score driven by the variational derivative δΦ associated with inserting a token into the sentence.

Third is the construction of statistics that recover attention. The paper argues that the statistics must encode token-token interaction, and it builds such a statistic using Luce’s choice axiom truncated at the lowest relational order. That truncation is the key modeling move: it keeps the simplest pairwise relational structure while avoiding higher-order interactions that would lead to more complex predictive rules. Under this choice, the last-token predictive distribution becomes a softmax choice rule, with mean parameter given by an attention cross-moment. The query-key matrix Λ = Q^T K appears as the bilinear interaction parameter, while the value matrix V corresponds to the direction in which the statistic is read out. In that sense, attention is not postulated first and justified later; it is induced by the constrained posterior over random measures.

The paper also extends the construction to causal and multi-head settings. In the causal case, positional information is folded into the state space or the statistics so that the predictive law depends only on the visible prefix. In the multi-head case, different heads correspond to different statistic channels or parameter blocks. The embedding and unembedding stages are discussed separately, since the main derivation works directly on spherical token states. The scope is therefore clear: the paper explains the attention sublayer, not the full residual-MLP-stack training dynamics of modern Transformers.88:T5b1,This is not an empirical scaling paper. Its main results are theoretical statements and derivations rather than benchmark numbers. The key deliverables are:

1. A constrained KL minimization problem over laws on random measures, with conditions under which the optimizer exists and has Gibbs form.
2. A predictive law for the last token under that Gibbs posterior, expressed through a score involving the variational derivative of the chosen sentence-level statistics.
3. A specific statistic built from a low-order truncation of Luce’s choice axiom, under which the predictive rule becomes softmax and the mean parameter is identified with an attention cross-moment.
4. Parallel derivations for unordered, causal, and multi-head variants, showing that the framework is not limited to the simplest bag-of-tokens setting.

From a pretraining perspective, the important observation is what the paper does not claim. It does not show that standard next-token Transformer training explicitly optimizes this entropy projection objective. It does not train large models with this objective and compare perplexity or downstream performance. The evidence is therefore mathematical coherence rather than empirical superiority. The strongest takeaway is structural: once one accepts spherical token states, an unstructured prior, sentence-level constraints, and a low-order Luce-style relational statistic, softmax attention is no longer an arbitrary design choice.89:T79c,Read it in the order of setup, entropy projection, statistic design, then extensions.

Start with the introduction and the early modeling sections to internalize the target of explanation. The paper is not trying to derive every component of the Transformer. It is trying to derive the attention mechanism as a predictive rule in a statistical model of language.

Then read carefully the section that formulates the KL minimization problem and proves the Gibbs-tilt solution. Focus on the assumptions behind existence and uniqueness, and on how the last-token predictive law is extracted from the posterior. This is the mathematical backbone.

Next, spend most of the time on the construction of Φ and on the role of the variational derivative δΦ. The genuinely interesting part is not that maximum entropy gives an exponential family; that is standard. The interesting part is which statistics make the predictive score look exactly like attention.

The section based on Luce’s choice axiom deserves the closest reading. That is where softmax appears for a reason rather than by fiat, and where the bilinear query-key interaction is selected instead of a more complicated higher-order form. If you only track one chain of formulas, track the one that turns the last-token conditional law into a softmax and identifies its mean parameter with the attention cross-moment.

After that, read the causal and multi-head extensions as a coverage check: can the framework accommodate the structures that matter in actual Transformers? The embedding/unembedding discussion can be deferred if time is limited.

Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. Which assumptions are mathematically convenient versus empirically plausible for trained representations? And can this constrained-law viewpoint be generalized to masked, any-order, diffusion, or energy-based language models? The paper does not answer that, but it opens a useful route.8a:T8db,The setup fine-tunes the base LM to explain itself, rather than training a separate probe. Given an input x and a natural-language query qc that specifies a target locale c inside the model, the system must report the corresponding internal signal. The locale can identify a layer, token position, neuron index, attention head, or attention source-target pair. The authors first cache the true activation a_c(x) from the original forward pass, then train a LoRA-adapted version of the same model to output a discretized or verbalized prediction of that signal conditioned on (x, qc). Because the target is the model's own low-level state, supervision is exact and can be generated at scale.

The central methodological move is to separate endogenous and intervention settings. In the endogenous case, the target signal arises naturally from the input. In the intervention case, the target internal variable is explicitly modified during the forward pass. The paper argues that many prior introspection setups can be solved by detecting that something unusual was injected, rather than by reading the intended internal state. To address this, the authors compare ordinary SFT against interventional training, where intervention examples are included during training so that correlated shortcuts become less reliable and the model is pushed toward the actual target signal.

The mechanism analysis goes beyond behavior. The authors trace the attention heads involved in moving information relevant to introspection. They find that endogenous and intervention reporting rely on overlapping but distinct circuits. Endogenous reporting often uses a larger set of heads to transport naturally occurring internal information, while intervention-related heads behave more like gates that selectively attend to the introspection token when an intervention is present. This distinction is important: being able to report an injected anomaly is not the same capability as reading naturally generated internal states.

Relative to external explainers or hidden-state probes, the paper's distinguishing feature is that the same model is trained to report its own low-level signals in context, under a setup where causal interventions make bypass diagnosable rather than invisible.8b:T640,The study trains hundreds of introspectors across models, signal types, and target locales. Four findings stand out. First, standard SFT can achieve high empirical reporting accuracy, but intervention-based tests and circuit analysis reveal substantial causal bypass. In other words, good answers do not guarantee that the model is using the intended internal variable. Second, adding interventions during training improves reporting of endogenous signals, with especially clear gains on out-of-distribution data. That suggests the method is not just fitting templates; it is making the model rely on more robust internal evidence. Third, generalization is asymmetric: transfer across token positions is relatively good, but transfer to unseen neurons or unseen layers is weak. The paper argues that this looks more like a coverage issue than a hard capability limit, since adding data for more neurons and layers improves performance. Fourth, the circuit analysis shows partially overlapping but functionally distinct attention heads for endogenous versus intervention reporting; endogenous circuits often involve more heads, while intervention circuits look more selective and gate-like.

The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, so exact scores are not recoverable here. Still, the experimental structure is already informative: the authors do not rely on a single average accuracy metric, but separate endogenous vs intervention, in-distribution vs OOD, and seen vs unseen positions/layers/neurons. That makes the conclusions much stronger than a standard finetuning benchmark.8c:T402,Start with the introduction. The main point is not that neuron activations are intrinsically the most important introspection target, but that they are precise, intervenable, and falsifiable, which makes them ideal for studying causal bypass. Then read the method section carefully to understand how locales are defined and how endogenous and intervention examples differ.

After that, go straight to the main behavioral results comparing standard SFT and interventional training, especially on endogenous and OOD evaluations. Then read the generalization experiments over token positions, neurons, and layers. Those results tell you what the model is actually learning. Finally, read the mechanism-analysis figures on attention heads, since they provide the strongest evidence that intervention reporting and endogenous reporting are related but not identical circuits.

A useful skim should take around 25-35 minutes. If time is limited, focus on the task setup, the main comparison tables, and the circuit-analysis section.8d:T8e7,方法上，作者延续 representation engineering 的思路，但把对象从“拒答”这类近似二元门控行为，换成了连续的生成式修辞策略。具体做法是：先构造一个 1000 条的配对数据集，每个概念都要求模型分别给出 literal explanation 和 analogical explanation。数据来自 ELI5 相关社区问答，经过两轮 LLM 过滤与标注：先筛掉不适合做结构类比的意见类、政策类问题，再按 biology、chemistry、CS/technology、earth/environment、economics、engineering、history/society、physics 八个领域做近均匀采样。训练/验证/测试切分为 600/100/300。

在每一层，作者取最终 prompt token 的 residual activation，分别对 analogy 与 literal 两组求均值，做 difference-in-means，得到该层的 Analogy Vector。推理时在指定层把该向量按系数 α 加到残差流上，观察输出风格是否朝类比解释偏移。这里有两个技术点比较关键。第一，作者系统比较了七组 matched base/instruct 模型，覆盖 Gemma-2、Llama-3.1、Qwen-2.5，参数规模 2B 到 32B，用同一套提取与干预流程来比较“方向是否存在”和“方向是否可用”。第二，他们发现高系数干预会出现 mode collapse，原因不是语义方向本身失效，而是 lexical entanglement：向量里混入了明显的词汇触发成分，尤其是 “Imagine” token 的 unembedding 方向约占总范数的 10%，会把模型硬推向模板化开头。为此作者把向量投影到与该 token 方向正交的子空间，范数只下降 1%–5%，说明主体信号仍是语义性的，而不是单纯的词触发。

更有意思的是作者提出的“behavioral accessibility”框架。不是只看能否提取出方向，而是看该方向注入后，模型分布是否真的发生可传播、可利用的变化。这里他们用两类信号来刻画：一类是输出质量和 analogy score 的提升；另一类是干预前后 token 分布的 KL divergence。后者被作者解释为 wiring diagnostic：即使模型最终没生成高质量类比，只要 KL 明显上升，说明这条方向至少接入了生成路径；如果 KL 很低，则更像是几何上有痕迹，但没有被行为电路有效读取。8e:T926,The method follows the representation-engineering line of work, but moves from near-binary behaviors such as refusal to a continuous generative style. The authors build a paired dataset of 1,000 concepts, each eliciting both a literal explanation and an analogical explanation. The source is ELI5-style community QA data, filtered in two stages with an external LLM: first to keep only mechanism-like concepts suitable for structural analogy, then to assign each item to one of eight domains for near-balanced sampling. The final split is 600/100/300 for train/validation/test.

For each layer, they collect the residual activation at the final prompt token and compute a difference-in-means vector between analogy and literal examples. This yields a layer-wise Analogy Vector. At inference time, they add the vector with coefficient alpha to the residual stream before the attention and MLP blocks, then measure whether the output shifts toward analogical explanation style.

Two technical details matter. First, they run the same extraction-and-steering pipeline on seven matched base/instruct pairs from Gemma-2, Llama-3.1, and Qwen-2.5, spanning 2B to 32B parameters. This lets them compare not just whether the direction exists, but whether it is behaviorally usable. Second, they identify a concrete failure mode at high steering strength: lexical entanglement. The vector partially aligns with the unembedding direction of the token “Imagine,” which accounts for about 10% of the vector norm and can force templated generations. They remove this by orthogonalizing the steering vector against that token direction. The norm drops by only 1%–5%, suggesting the main signal is semantic rather than lexical.

The broader contribution is the behavioral accessibility framework. The paper argues that extracting a direction is not enough; one must test whether the intervention actually enters the model’s generation circuitry. To measure this, they use both output-side quality metrics and KL divergence between steered and unsteered token distributions. They interpret KL as a wiring diagnostic: even if the final generations are not yet good analogies, a substantial KL shift indicates that the direction is connected to the decoding pathway. Low KL suggests a representation that is geometrically present but behaviorally inert.8f:T5d8,The central empirical result is that the Analogy Vector can be extracted from every base model tested, but accessibility varies continuously with instruction exposure rather than following a clean base-versus-instruct split. Gemma-2 base models, where pretraining and instruction tuning are more cleanly separated, show flat steering landscapes and much lower KL divergence than their instruct counterparts. The direction is there, but it barely moves behavior. Qwen-2.5 base models, where instruction-like data is more entangled with pretraining, already show partial accessibility. Llama-3.1 sits between these two regimes.

On the held-out set of 300 prompts, the paper reports that steering Gemma-2-9B-IT with the extracted direction improves the harmonic mean of literal quality and analogy quality from 3.22 to 3.94, a gain of about 22%. A small human validation study supports the use of the LLM judge for analogy quality. Another useful result is the base-instruct cosine similarity analysis: Qwen base/instruct pairs remain geometrically close, while Gemma pairs show larger reorganization, consistent with the idea that instruction tuning amplifies and hooks into existing structure in Qwen but reshapes it more substantially in Gemma. The appendix analysis of high-alpha failures is also informative: once the “Imagine” component is removed, mode collapse is reduced, indicating that many steering failures come from lexical leakage rather than the absence of a semantic direction.90:T54c,A two-phase auditing pipeline.
Phase 1 (candidate discovery): define forced-choice behavior via the logit margin between the gold option and the strongest competing option, plus auxiliary measures (entropy, gold/wrong probabilities). Encode residual-stream activations with pretrained Gemma Scope SAEs, pool feature activations over specific spans (max-pooling over tokens), and rank features using L1-regularized logistic probes for several binary targets (e.g., Wrong vs Correct, low vs high margin, wrong-high-confidence variants) and ridge regression for continuous targets (margin/entropy). Complement probes with statistical audits (Pearson/Spearman correlations, bootstrap mean-difference intervals, mutual information estimates).
Artifact-risk screening: for sufficiently supported features, explicitly test confounds tied to evaluation structure (answer letter, prompt template, answer permutation, topic/content cues). Convert each confound score to within-run percentiles and filter out high-risk features.
Phase 2 (causal evaluation): perform feature steering/interventions and measure distributional shifts in margins and actual answer flips (wrong→correct), with random-active feature controls. The paper emphasizes that large logit influence and high predictiveness are insufficient without artifact independence and stable causal effects.91:T62e,The task is deliberately simple. There are four labeled boxes and four letters A–D. Starting from an initial arrangement, the model must apply k swaps, with k in {2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24}, writing the full state after each swap and then the final answer. Because every intermediate state is deterministic, step correctness can be scored exactly. The key intervention is the Edit condition: after the model has produced a partial chain up to step m, the state at step m is replaced with a different but valid arrangement, and the model is asked to continue. If the continuation and final answer evolve consistently from the corrupted state, the run is labeled follows-edit; if the model returns to the true trajectory, it is labeled repair; other categories capture additional failure modes.

This design has several strengths. The intervention is applied to the model’s own chain rather than to an externally written explanation, so it directly tests whether the model uses previously written text as computational input. The corrupted state is valid, which prevents trivial rejection based on malformed formatting. The paper also separates compliance, prefix accuracy, CoT accuracy, and direct accuracy, so reliance is not conflated with formatting failures, low capability, or answer bias.

The evaluation spans 25 open-weight models: Qwen3 size series with both base and post-trained variants, Gemma 3, Llama 3, and multiple OLMo 2 pretraining checkpoints. The protocol runs on a single 16GB GPU, which makes it a practical diagnostic rather than a one-off large-scale benchmark.92:T6b3,There are five headline findings. First, reliance rises monotonically with size and then saturates. In Qwen3, the follows-edit rate is well fit by a logistic curve in log parameter count, with a midpoint near 1B, reaching 0.97–1.00 by 14B. Gemma 3 and Llama 3 show the same qualitative trend. Second, capability is the main explanatory variable. Across all 25 models, reliance and step accuracy correlate at about r = 0.99; at matched capability, models from different families and sizes show similar reliance, such as 1.7B Qwen3, 4B Gemma 3, and 8B Llama 3. Third, size still matters beyond raw correctness: even when restricting to items the model originally solved correctly before the edit, reliance continues to increase with size among capable models. Fourth, post-training is not the main driver. For Qwen3, base and post-trained checkpoints differ by at most about ±0.03 in reliance from 4B upward; the only large gap appears at 1.7B and coincides with a large capability gap. Fifth, for k >= 4, direct answering without a chain stays at chance for all capable models, with mean accuracy 0.041 versus the theoretical 1/24 ≈ 0.042. That strongly suggests there is no hidden internal shortcut on this task at these scales: if the model solves it, it does so by using the explicit step-by-step trace.

The OLMo 2 checkpoint results are also informative as a limitation. The authors intended to probe the training-token axis, but those checkpoints never cross the capability threshold needed for the task, so the token-scaling analysis remains inconclusive. That itself is useful: more pretraining tokens do not automatically place a model in the high-reliance regime on this kind of serial reasoning task.93:T4cd,The evaluation uses fact-checked PolitiFact claims from LIAR-PLUS, collapsed into true and false classes after filtering for length, attribution, first-person wording, and image-dependent phrasing. Each prompt asks a fact-checking assistant to answer whether a social-media post is true or false. The account profile is randomized across age, gender, origin, education, occupation, track record, followers, party, and irrelevant attributes. Occupation and education are sampled jointly to keep profiles plausible. The primary condition uses natural biography lines rather than explicit profile cards. The metric reads next-token probabilities after “Answer:” and renormalizes over several single-token spellings of True and False. The job gap is measured in probit space, either through claim-fixed-effect regression for randomized profiles or paired differences for minimal pairs. For OLMo-2 32B, the paper examines base, SFT, DPO, and final checkpoints. It builds a difference-of-means status direction in the residual stream and tests it with activation steering. The key mechanistic result is that post-training does not simply make occupation more salient; it changes the sign with which the model uses that information.94:T505,The authors use a controlled FaithEval-style setting with two documents that answer the same factual slot differently. Qwen 0.8B is the main mechanistic model, and Gemma 3 1B is used as a transfer check. Source-choice labels are obtained through answer-alias matching, while disclosure labels are produced by an LLM judge with categories such as one-sided answers, conflict-aware leaning answers, strict unresolved disclosure, weak disclosure, and truncation. For source choice, the paper fits a mean-difference direction in the residual stream: the normalized difference between the residual centroids for Document 1 and Document 2 answers. This direction is used both as a readout and as a steering vector. In Qwen, the selected source-choice direction is at layer 13 and the mean_decision position; steering is applied at the output of layer 12 so that layer 13 receives the edited residual. The paper then uses CETT to identify sparse MLP neurons whose activation and down-projection norm imply a large contribution to the MLP residual write. The actual neuron writes are projected onto the source-choice direction to test whether those sparse writers feed the same coordinate. Conflict disclosure is modeled separately and appears later, at layer 17 and pre_response_last in Qwen.95:T46d,The authors recast Neural Thickets as a Perturb-Select-Vote procedure. PSV samples N perturbed predictors, scores them on a small task-specific validation set, keeps the top K members, and aggregates their predictions by majority vote. Full-weight RandOpt is one instance of this template. The paper then weakens the perturbation space step by step: perturbing all parameters, perturbing a subset of layers, perturbing a single decoder block, and finally perturbing no weights at all. In the logit-only variant, the model is fully frozen and each member receives a fixed random Gaussian bias added to its output logits throughout autoregressive generation, followed by greedy decoding. A first-order argument supports this move: small weight perturbations affect predictions primarily through the logit shifts they induce. The paper also separates the roles of sampling, selection, and voting. On stronger base models, temperature-tuned sampling with majority voting already matches much of full-weight PSV; on weaker models, validation-based selection remains more important because it filters unreliable members before aggregation.96:T413,The paper reproduces the large gains reported by Gan and Isola, including the Countdown example where Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct improves from 10.8% to 63.6% under the original perturbation setup. The central empirical result is that full-weight perturbation is not necessary. Perturbing a single decoder block recovers much of the gain, and logit-only PSV often matches or exceeds full-weight PSV. On MATH-500 with OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, the base model scores 63.3%, full-weight perturbation ensemble reaches 74.7%, and logit-only PSV reaches 81.3%. The PSV runs use large perturbation budgets, typically N from 1000 to 5000, and a selection set of about 200 target-task examples. The paper also evaluates pretrained vision backbones under domain shift. There, logit-only PSV uses one trained linear probe and perturbs class logits, while full-weight PSV perturbs the backbone and trains one probe per member. The same pattern holds: output-space perturbations recover the gains of full-weight perturbations and can improve out-of-domain performance.97:T420,The study uses a counterfactual fairness setup. The authors take 120 real emergency department cases from MIMIC-IV and create demographic swaps while keeping the clinical content fixed. They run a full factorial design over five model families and four aggregation topologies, yielding 20 model-by-topology cells. The analysis compares independent agent outputs with the final committed team decision. The central mechanism is called disparity laundering: the team optimizes within-version quantities such as agreement, coherence, and clinical plausibility, but the fairness property lives between paired counterfactual versions of the same patient. Since no agent observes both versions, the deliberation process cannot distinguish a harmful dissent from an error to be smoothed out. The paper tests late-stage interventions such as fairness instructions, demographic masking, and per-agent self-debiasing. It then introduces a Diverse-Perspective Ensemble that makes counterfactual versions visible inside the team and pools them into the final decision.98:T5c7,The setup is simple and appropriately controlled. The authors evaluate Qwen3.5-0.8B, Qwen3.5-2B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Llama-3.2-3B, and Gemma-4-E2B with a minimal prompt of the form “x1 × x2 =”, using greedy decoding to avoid chain-of-thought or tool use masking the raw failure pattern. The dataset contains 16,991 multiplication problems spanning 1x1, 1x2, 2x2, 2x3, 2x4, 3x3, and 3x4 settings. Small spaces are exhaustively enumerated; larger ones are uniformly sampled.
The analysis has three layers. First, they measure exact-answer and per-digit accuracy as operand length grows. Second, they port the carry-potential framework from Wen et al. on addition and test whether multiplication errors also form the characteristic bathtub-shaped curve around integer boundaries. Third, after finding that this pattern does not hold cleanly, they inspect the structure of wrong digits themselves. The main empirical observation is a new regime in small Qwen models: lower-order digit errors often preserve parity, while higher-order errors look more like off-by-one carry failures.
That last point is the real contribution. It suggests multiplication errors are not generated by a single source of discretization noise. Lower columns may be governed by local multiplication-table-like heuristics, while higher columns are more affected by carry propagation. This is a better fit to the computational structure of multiplication than a direct transfer of the addition hypothesis.99:T565,The experimental scale is modest but the design is clean. The dataset has 16,991 problems: 81 for 1x1, 810 for 1x2, 8,100 for 2x2, and sampled subsets for larger settings, including 3,000 each for 2x3 and 3x3, and 1,000 each for 2x4 and 3x4. All models are run with greedy decoding and up to 10 generated tokens, with regex-based answer extraction.
Three findings matter most. First, digit-level error rate versus carry potential does not reproduce the clear bathtub shape seen in addition. The authors argue this is because multiplication has much larger and more variable carry potentials, and because errors from partial products and subsequent summation are entangled. Their 99 x 99 example is illustrative: the tens-column raw sum is 162, and with the previous carry the carry potential can reach 17, far beyond the small bounded values typical in addition.
Second, carry still matters, but it is not a sufficient explanatory variable. Errors increase with more complex carry structure, yet they do not localize neatly around integer thresholds.
Third, small Qwen models exhibit a specific structure: low-order digit mistakes often preserve parity, whereas high-order mistakes resemble off-by-one carry failures. The paper is more about error morphology than headline accuracy, so the figures and qualitative distributions are more informative than any single aggregate score.9a:T836,The system is built around an Explorer–Builder–Verifier loop, with explicit source evidence as the shared interface. The Explorer–Builder collects browser-observable evidence from a real site under a given scope and budget. The evidence includes page structure, computed styles, element geometry, screenshots, resource references, and before/after observations around interactions. A notable design choice is that different interaction states at the same URL are treated as distinct evidence units. That is necessary if the goal is to reconstruct state transitions rather than static snapshots.

The Builder converts this evidence into a local executable environment: routes, components, shared object relations, state transitions, fixed initial states, reset mechanisms, and task evaluators. The reconstruction target is intentionally bounded by a site contract. The system does not try to infer hidden backend logic beyond what the evidence supports. In that sense, it is closer to contract-bounded replayable reconstruction than to full website cloning.

The Verifier is the key differentiator. It runs independently on frozen candidates and checks them against source evidence and site contracts. When it finds a discrepancy, the system asks whether the available evidence is sufficient to support a concrete correction. If yes, the issue is treated as an implementation bug and sent to local repair. If not, the problem is treated as an evidence gap and triggers targeted recapture from the source site. The updated candidate is then frozen and reverified. This separation between evidence-supported repair and evidence-insufficient recapture is the central mechanism that distinguishes the work from one-shot generative reconstruction pipelines.

The broader design trade-off is clear. The paper avoids the high-quality but low-scale route of manual mirrors, and also avoids purely generative site synthesis that scales but may drift from the source. It chooses browser-evidence-driven reconstruction because the target is a training/evaluation environment, not an open-ended web simulator.9b:T70b,The evaluation covers scale, fidelity, and downstream utility.

On scale, the resource pool contains 244 website artifacts across 14 domains and 53 categories. That is enough to show the system is not limited to a handful of showcase sites.

On environment quality, the paper compares against five matched WebHarbor sites and 14 historical states. WebAnything achieves better automated fidelity metrics and wins a blind overall-fidelity audit with 12 wins, 2 ties, and 0 losses. This is an important choice of evaluation target: the paper is trying to preserve source correspondence, so fidelity matters more than raw task success alone. Separate interaction tests are used to characterize functional coverage, which is also the right move because visual similarity does not guarantee executable behavior. The historical analysis identifies evidence-supported discrepancies in 39 pairs across 22 sites, and independently reverifies the resolution of 18 issue records across 6 sites. That part is especially useful because it validates the repair loop, not just the final outputs.

For downstream utility, the environments support 12,984 executed and accepted tasks. The resulting trajectories are used for SFT, improving Qwen3.5-9B on REAL, Odysseys-Easy, and WebArena-Verified Overall. The excerpt provided does not include the exact gains, so the main takeaway is qualitative but still meaningful: the automatically reconstructed environments are good enough to produce training data that transfers to agent performance.

The strongest evidence comes from the combination of three experiment types: fidelity against manually mirrored environments, discrepancy-to-repair records, and downstream SFT gains. Together they make the case that this is a usable environment factory rather than a demo system.9c:T4e5,Start with the introduction, especially the taxonomy of prior approaches: manual mirrors, generative construction, and capture-and-replay. The paper frames its problem well, and the definitions of the source-grounding gap and verification gap are worth reading carefully. Then focus on the main system figure and the interfaces between Explorer–Builder and Verifier. The key question while reading is how evidence is represented and propagated.

Two details deserve close attention. First, the treatment of different interaction states at the same URL as separate evidence units. Second, the logic that decides between local repair and targeted recapture after verification fails. That decision rule is where most of the paper’s real technical substance sits.

In the experiments, prioritize the fidelity comparison with WebHarbor, the discrepancy-resolution analysis, and the downstream SFT results. If time is limited, the method overview figure plus the main fidelity and issue-resolution tables should be enough for a solid read in about 25–35 minutes. If reading more deeply, examine how much manual effort remains in defining site contracts, and whether targeted recapture scales to longer, deeper workflows rather than shallow interactions.9d:T66a,The method has two parts. The first is CoC-CFG. The model runs the frozen action expert twice: once with the full context C_full, and once with a reference context C_ref where only the reasoning span is removed. At Euler step k, it computes two velocities, v_with and v_without, and interpolates along the line between them with a guidance weight w_k. Setting w_k=1 recovers the original policy, w_k=0 removes the reasoning influence, and w_k>1 amplifies it. This turns trust in reasoning from a binary keep/drop decision into a controllable scalar.

The second part is Q-adaptive guidance. The choice of w_k at each step is formulated as an MDP over a finite action set of guidance weights. The key move is to avoid standard bootstrapped RL. Because the expert is frozen, the initial noise is fixed, and the generation process can be reset to any step, the value of taking one candidate weight at one step can be measured exactly: branch for one step with that weight, then finish the rollout under the current controller, and use the final task score as the action value. Small critics are trained to regress these measured Q-values, with an added penalty for deviating from a reference weight. The controller is then improved, new values are re-measured under the improved controller, and the critics are refit on the accumulated measurements.

Relative to prior work, the differences are clear. It does not try to detect hallucinated reasoning. It does not fine-tune the VLA or update the expert online. And it does not rely on SAC-style or GRPO-style bootstrapping from sparse terminal rewards when exact one-step branching is available.9e:T599,The evaluation has two main parts: Alpasim and Waymo. In Alpasim, a simulator reconstructed from real driving logs, Q-adaptive guidance reduces open-loop displacement cost by 16.5% relative to the original w=1 policy. In closed-loop evaluation, it passes 262 out of 300 scenes, compared with 252 for the baseline. Under the same reward signal, it also outperforms SAC and GRPO, which supports the paper’s claim that measured-Q fitting is better matched to this setting than generic online RL.

On the Waymo end-to-end driving benchmark, the paper compares against fixed guidance weights, four adaptive-guidance baselines, SAC, GRPO, and the original Alpamayo 1.5. The reported result is that the first three stages of the proposed controller already beat all fixed-weight settings and the adaptive/RL baselines on held-out frames. After rule-based conversion to the Waymo vehicle, Alpamayo 1.5 with Q-adaptive guidance reaches 8.135159 RFS on the hidden test set, above the published 8.079 baseline. The absolute gain is modest, but hidden-test improvement matters more than open-loop-only gains.

The most useful ablation insight is that no single global guidance weight works well across scenes or across Euler steps. Another important result is that measured-Q fitting beats SAC and GRPO, which is exactly what the method is designed to exploit: when exact branch evaluation is possible, bootstrapping becomes unnecessary noise.9f:T87a,方法名是 Continuous-Action World Models，核心对象是 latent action function。作者不把动作看成固定长度、固定频率的命令序列，而是把一段动作表示成带时间戳的样本点 {(τ_i,a_i,m_i)}，其中 m_i 记录哪些动作分量有效。编码器 E_ϕ 把这些时间采样点压到固定大小的 latent function Z，解码器 D_ψ 接收 Z 和任意物理时间 query τ，输出该时刻的 end-effector action。这样同一动作可以在不同采样频率下被观测和重建，也可以在推理时按目标控制频率重新查询。

训练分两阶段。Stage A 是 function pretraining。作者用一个 Mixture-of-Transformers 编码器分别处理位置、姿态、夹爪等动作流，再通过联合注意力融合，学习跨动作分量的共享表示。预训练目标至少包括两类：一是动作重建，让 latent function 能从时间查询恢复原始轨迹；二是 temporal sampling view consistency，让同一物理动作在不同采样频率、不同时间视图下映射到一致表示。这个设计的关键不是做更强的自编码，而是让 heterogeneous trajectory 在“物理时间”坐标系里对齐，从而扩大可用于预训练的数据池。

Stage B 是把 pretrained function space 接到 world-model backbone。输入侧包括视觉观测、语言指令、机器人 proprioception，以及预测的未来视觉特征；预测头输出 latent function，再由共享 decoder 按指定 query times 解码成动作。文中提到 current visual features 通过 output residual 进入预测头，说明作者不想让 latent function 完全承担当前观测的低层细节，而是更偏向承载跨 embodiment 的 dynamics prior。训练时既监督 latent representation，也监督解码后的动作，形成 representation-level 和 action-level 的双重约束。

和常见 robot policy / world model 的区别在于：它不是直接学 observation-to-action，也不是把不同机器人动作简单投到统一离散 token 空间，而是先定义一个连续时间、固定容量、可跨频率查询的中间函数空间。这个中间层是全文真正的创新点。a0:T7ca,The method, Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), centers on a latent action function. Instead of representing an action as a fixed-length command sequence, the paper uses timestamped action samples {(tau_i, a_i, m_i)}, where m_i indicates valid components. An encoder maps these samples into a fixed-size latent function Z, and a decoder takes Z plus arbitrary physical-time queries to produce end-effector actions. This makes it possible to observe the same motion at one sampling rate and execute or reconstruct it at another.

Training has two stages. Stage A is function pretraining. A Mixture-of-Transformers encoder processes position, orientation, and gripper streams with specialized branches and joint attention. The pretraining objectives include action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views, so that the same physical motion observed at different frequencies maps to a shared representation. The point is not just better autoencoding; it is to align heterogeneous trajectories in a common physical-time space and thereby enlarge the pool of usable pretraining data.

Stage B connects the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone. The prediction head consumes visual observations, language instructions, robot proprioception, and predicted future visual features, with current visual features added through an output residual. It predicts a latent action function, and the shared decoder turns that function into actions at query times chosen for the desired execution frequency. Training supervises both the latent representation and the decoded actions, giving the model both representation-level and action-level constraints.

Compared with standard robot policies or world models, the key difference is that the paper does not directly learn observation-to-action mappings in a fixed discrete-time space, and it does not force all robots into a naive shared action tokenization. The continuous-time latent function is the actual contribution.a1:T488,The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so the exact numbers are not available here. From the method and framing, the critical evaluations are likely to be: action reconstruction quality under heterogeneous temporal sampling, consistency of the latent space across different frequency views, downstream action generation when execution frequency is changed at inference time, and transfer across embodiments.

The paper’s central empirical claim is that Stage A broadens the trajectory sources that can contribute to pretraining, while Stage B turns that shared prior into observation-conditioned action generation. The most important numbers to verify in the full paper are: how many embodiments and frequency settings are used in pretraining, how much latent-function supervision helps over direct action supervision, and how much performance degrades when the decoder is queried at unseen execution frequencies. If gains only appear as within-embodiment interpolation, the contribution is mostly engineering. If cross-embodiment transfer remains strong, the work is much more relevant as a unified pretraining approach.a2:T406,A 20-minute skim is enough. Start with the introduction and the main method figure to lock in the central claim: actions should be modeled as functions, not fixed-rate sequences. Then read the definition of the latent function and the physical-time interface carefully. After that, focus on Stage A, especially the consistency objective across temporal sampling views; that is what separates this from a standard behavior-cloning autoencoder. Finally, read how Stage B attaches the pretrained function space to the world-model backbone and how inference-time query times determine execution frequency.

If time is limited, spend less effort on robotics setup details and more on the ablations: no function pretraining, no consistency loss, no shared decoder, or single-frequency-only training. Those comparisons determine whether the method is actually learning a reusable prior or just smoothing trajectories. continual-learning recipes for LLMs select what to learn based on surprise (token-level NLL), keeping the most “novel” claims from a stream. The goal is to characterize how badly surprise-based selection fails under poisoning, and which additional gating mechanisms (external verification, prior-conflict detection, regression testing with rollback, evidence routing) can reduce poisoning without completely stopping legitimate updates.","importance":"For pretraining/continual-pretraining research, the main impact is diagnostic and architectural rather than a new objective:\n- It shows that “surprise as a novelty proxy” is not a safe default in open-world updates; it can actively prioritize known-fact lies. This is relevant anywhere NLL/perplexity drives filtering, curricula, online distillation, or streaming adaptation.\n- It decomposes continual learning safety into separable signals (novelty, contradiction-to-prior, external truth judgment, collateral-damage tests) and quantifies what each can and cannot detect.\n- It provides a clear negative result: regression tests on unrelated knowledge can throttle learning yet fail to filter targeted factual poisoning, because the update can be highly localized.\n- It highlights the practical ceiling of verifier-based defenses: reliability becomes “as good as the judge,” with corresponding cost and attack surface.","technical_approach":"$1a","experiments":"$1b","reading_guide":"Skim plan (30–45 minutes):\n- Read the Introduction for the threat model and the four research questions; the key takeaway is “surprise selects lies” plus the regression-test negative result.\n- In Method, focus on the exact definitions of the four keys, especially why prior-conflict must be computed with θ0 (base) rather than the current adapter.\n- Jump to the main results sections (the paper points to 5.1–5.6 and transfer in 5.7–5.8). gradients during training. A longer backward window improves learning per token because credit assignment reaches deeper into the repeated computation, but it also makes each update more expensive. A shorter window reduces backward cost, so under a fixed wall-clock budget it can run more optimizer steps and consume more tokens. The key question is not which window is better at a fixed token count, but whether the preferred choice changes as the training budget grows. That is the practically relevant setting for pretraining, where the constraint is usually total compute or elapsed training time rather than a fixed number of tokens.","importance":"Its value for pretraining is twofold. First, it reframes truncated backpropagation in recurrent/shared-depth LMs as a budget-dependent recipe choice rather than a static architectural preference. The main result is simple: at small budgets, shorter windows often win because extra updates are worth more; at larger budgets, that advantage shrinks systematically. Second, the paper provides a clean decomposition of the matched-time outcome into two components: per-token efficiency from deeper backpropagation, and extended-training gains from cheaper updates. Both diminish as budget increases, but the gains from extra updates diminish faster. That mechanism is likely relevant beyond looped LMs, including truncated BPTT, shared-parameter depth, and other settings where one trades deeper credit assignment against more optimization steps.","technical_approach":"$1f","experiments":"$20","reading_guide":"Start with the Introduction, especially the distinction between per-token efficiency and extended-training gains. routing heads，对同一组共享专家从不同参数视角打分。每个路由头先输出 sigmoid 分数，然后把这些 post-sigmoid 分数相加，再做一次共享的 top-k 选择。作者强调必须是 sigmoid 之后再求和，而不是先加 logits 再过非线性；后者在形式上会退化成一个单线性打分器，失去多视角意义。多个路由头没有额外 diversity penalty，只靠不同初始化打破对称性，训练后会自然形成差异化偏好。聚合后的分数既能让“被某一个 router 强烈偏好”的专家入选，也能让“被多个 router 中等支持”的专家入选。\n\nMulti-View 在此基础上进一步让路由偏好参与专家计算本身。问题在于，单纯把多个 router 分数求和后，保留不了各 router 的相对偏好信息；例如两个 router 分别给出 (0.4, 0.1) 和 (0.2, 0.3) 时，总和都可能一样，但语义不同。为此，作者给每个 router 配一个 learned latent projection，对应一个 latent view。对于每个被选中的专家，不是直接吃同一个共享下投影输入，而是先根据该专家在各 router 上的原始分数，跨 router 归一化得到 mixing weights，再把多个 latent views 混合成该专家专属的输入。关键点在于：这种 mixing 发生在 dispatch 之前，但每个被选专家仍只做一次前向，因此 active-expert count、expert FLOPs、通信量都不变。\n\n从设计取舍看，这个方案试图在两端之间找平衡：一端是标准 MoE，成本低但路由视角单一；另一端是对所有专家做部分或全部激活评估，信息更充分但代价高。Multi-View 通过复用 First, future-aware positional embeddings tell the model which position will be predicted next. In causal any-order generation, the same observed context can correspond to different target tokens. Without target-position information, the model receives conflicting gradients because identical contexts require different outputs. The proposed positional signal fixes this identifiability issue while preserving a single-stream causal Transformer. Second, the paper uses an ordering curriculum that gradually moves from raster-scan order to fully random permutations. A sudden switch to random orderings produces large, high-variance updates and damages the pretrained representations before the model learns flexible routing. not a pretraining-method contribution, but it is relevant to evaluation and training-signal quality. Batched LLM judging is widely used to reduce labeling and evaluation cost. If judgments depend on batch context, then labels used for benchmarks, automatic annotation, SFT data filtering, RL preference construction, or safety moderation can contain context-induced noise and systematic shifts. Aggregate AUROC or accuracy can remain nearly unchanged while many individual decisions flip, so standard validation may miss the problem.","technical_approach":"The authors formalize a batched judging context with three components: the item’s slot in the prompt, the membership of the batch, and the order of neighboring items. A judge is separable if the level assigned to an item is identical across all such contexts. The experiments grade the same 2,000 items per task alone and under multiple randomized batched conditions. The tasks are harm judgment for social-media comments, short-answer grading, and review star ratings. The main runs use five open-weight models in the 4–9B range, with follow-up runs on four 14–32B models. The design includes baselines such as renamed item keys, reworded instructions, and single-prompt generation. It also includes controlled changes to slot, neighbor order, and batch membership. 明确。然后系统性控制若干变量：每个事实被多少文档重复表达、总事实数、是否加入与 query 词面相似但语义无关的 lexical distractors、以及文档组织方式。这样可以单独观察每个因素如何影响 recall。\n\n第二部分是算法诊断与修正。作者先做 token-level attribution 分析，发现真正承载因果证据的通常只是文档中的少数 token，而标准做法常把 token 分数在整篇文档上平均或求和，导致背景 token 把信号稀释。围绕这个现象，作者测试了两个此前没有被充分重视的设计维度。其一是 loss：把常见 cross-entropy 换成 token-level negative log-odds。原因是当目标 token 已经被模型高置信预测时，cross-entropy 的梯度会接近 0，反而压低最关键证据的可见性；negative log-odds 去掉了这种 confidence saturation，更容易把支持目标输出的 token 拉出来。其二是 aggregation：不再对整篇文档平均，而是只取 top-k token attribution score 聚合成文档分数。这样做等于显式假设“证据是局部的”，从而对冗余文本和干扰词更稳健。\n\n论文并不局限于某一种 attribution estimator，而是在 TRAK、EK-FAC、Grad-Dot 等多种 gradient-based 方法上测试这些改动，说明作者关注的是 attribution pipeline 的公共瓶颈，而不是某个方法的局部调参。","experiments":"关键结果很集中。第一，CATT 上最显著的现象是 dilution：随着同一事实在更多文档中重复，或加入更多与 query 词面相似的 distractor，现有方法的 fact-tracing recall 明显下降。这个退化不是偶然噪声，而是在多种方法、多个数据设置下都稳定出现。第二，token-level negative log-odds 加上 top-k token aggregation 后，fact-tracing recall 在多种 attribution 方法和数据配置上提升 35 到 72 个百分点，幅度很大，说明问题主要出在信号提取和聚合，而不是只出在二阶近似或 influence 估计误差。\n\n第三，作者把结论外推到真实 benchmark FTRACE-TREX。这里不再有合成数据的绝对可控性，因此作者用 counterfactual retraining performance 作为外部验证。结果是对 TRAK、EK-FAC、Grad-Dot，token-level 都直接相关。更重要的是，论文实证表明 Pass@K 与 Seq@K 排名并不等价，说明如果只用反馈盲的指标做模型选择，可能会选错模型，也会误判训练方向。对基座研究员来说，这意味着两件事：第一，预训练或后训练是否提升了“反馈利用能力”，需要单独测；第二，未来做 reasoning / coding / tool-use H_{t-1}=((Y1,F1),...,(Y_{t-1},F_{t-1}))。因此两者在形式上都问“预算 K 内是否至少成功一次”，但一个考察独立采样覆盖率，另一个考察条件修正能力。\n\n论文的贡献不只是给出定义，还系统研究了 feedback mode。反馈可以来自 verifier、rubric-based critique、不同粒度的错误信息，甚至历史摘要方式也会影响结果。作者特别强调 RL 中的可验证奖励都会被污染。论文聚焦的现象是 stale authoritative information：模型先看到一个任务相关值，之后底层权威记录发生变化，模型在后续步骤里是否会基于过期信息做决定。关键难点不在于“加一个扰动”，而在于证明这个扰动确实发生、任务仍然可解、模型确实接收到了应有观察、最终判分也有证据支撑。","importance":"对预训练研究本身，它不是直接提出新的 能力里剥离出来，形成一套可执行认证流程。对于做基座模型的人，这件事有两层启发。第一，很多所谓 agent failure 其实是训练信号质量问题；如果环境变更、观测分发、checker 判定不可靠，RL 学到的是噪声奖励。第二，动态环境评测不能只给 terminal success rate，需要保留证据链，区分 authoritative state mutation、page benchmark，而是一套从任务构造、事前认证到事后审计的流程。作者先定义 phenomenon，即应用无关的环境变化类型；再用 executable perturbation 把它实例化，明确四个要素：状态变换算子、触发条件、观测通道、以及 single-execution guard，避免重复触发或副作用失控。随后，一个候选评测单元由 seeded world、perturbation、endpoint criteria 和 verifier 组成，但不会直接投入评测，而是先经过一组 scoped tests。根据引言给出的描述，这些测试至少覆盖五类：状态转移是否真的发生；观测是否一致地送达策略；任务在变更后是否仍可解；checker 是否能区分正确与错误行为；checker 本身对记录损坏或异常轨迹是否稳健。\n\n论文另一个重要设计是把“世界状态变化”和“信息披露方式”分开控制。在 clinic booking 与 insurance approval 两个场景里，底层 authoritative state 都会变化，但实验主比较不是“静态环境 vs 动态环境”，而是 review step 给 agent 多少更新信息。clinic 里有 OFF-A、CUE-A、LIVE-A：分别是不额外提示、提示去核验并给原始记录链接、直接展示当前更新值。insurance 里则是 OFF-A 与 ON-A：审批时是否重新暴露当前 policy。这样设计的好处是，作者测到的是 review-time information effect，而不是把多个因素混在一起。作者还强调 source page 始终可访问，因此“是否回看原始来源”被记录为行为，而不是预设成功条件。\n\n在评测有效性上，EnvOS 还要求 prospective experiments 预注册设计与计数规则，隔离 policy 与 evaluator 数据，并在运行后基于归档证据用独立代码重建 verdict terms。这个“separate code re-checks the verdict from archived evidence”的设计很关键，因为它把 grader 从单点信任对象变成可复核对象。对于依赖程序化奖励的 RL 训练，这等于在 reward pipeline 上加了一层审计。","experiments":"全文片段里给出的实验信息主要是定性和部分相对结论，没有完整表格数字，但主线很清楚。作者在两个应用上验证 EnvOS：一是 clinic booking，任务中诊所地点会在中途变化；二是 insurance-claim approval，policy limit 会在模型计算批准金额前发生变化。两者都要求先确认环境变更确实发生，再比较不同 review 信息条件下 agent 的表现。\n\n关键结果有三点。第一，在 clinic booking 中，直接把更新后的 location 展示给 agent 的 LIVE-A about making computer-use agents stronger. It addresses a more foundational issue: how to build and audit evaluations when the environment can change mid-episode in ways that alter the authoritative state. In such settings, an observed failure may come from the agent, from a perturbation that did not actually fire as intended, or from a grader/verifier that assigned the wrong verdict. The paper focuses on stale authoritative information: the agent first observes a task-relevant value, the underlying record changes later, and the agent must act after that change. The hard part is not adding a perturbation, but proving that the perturbation happened at the right time, that the task remained solvable, that the agent received the intended observations, and that the final judgment is supported by archived evidence.","importance":"For pretraining researchers, the contribution is indirect but useful, especially at the pretrain–post-train boundary. Its main contribution is methodological: it separates environment correctness and evaluation correctness from agent capability. That matters because many apparent agent failures are really training-signal failures. If state changes, observation delivery, or checkers are unreliable, the reward signal is corrupted before any policy learning issue enters the picture. The paper also offers a clean decomposition of dynamic-environment evaluation into authoritative state mutation, page serve, model observation, and agent comprehension. 的核心就是把这种混淆拆开，控制哪些样例必须依赖跨视角整合才能答对，哪些样例则可以被 shortcut 解掉。","importance":"对基座研究的意义主要在评测方法，而不是模型本身。它指出了一个常被忽略的评测漏洞：多图输入能力不等于多视角表征能力。这个区分对原生多模态预训练、具身 world modeling、视频/多帧 VLM、以及未来把多视角观测统一进同一 token space 的工作都很关键。更具体地说，这个 benchmark 提供了一种“控制证据需求”的评测设计思路：不是只看任务表面形式，而是看正确答案到底是否要求模型建立跨视角 correspondence。这个思路对长上下文、多模态记忆、agent perception 评测都有借鉴价值。","technical_approach":"方法上有三个设计点。第一，计数任务不是简单问“有几个物体”，而是按跨视角重叠关系分成 complete overlap、subset overlap、complementary views 三类。前两类可以用 max-count 这类简单规则得到正确答案，第三类则必须识别哪些实例在不同视角中是同一个物体，哪些是新出现的物体，因此真正要求 deduplication 和 cross-view correspondence。第二，一致性任务不是简单做图像差异检测，而是人为控制编辑发生在 shared region 还是 view-specific region。只有 shared region 的编辑才构成真正矛盾；如果编辑发生在另一视角不可见区域，两张图仍然是兼容的。这样可以测模型是否理解“哪些证据应该一致”。第三，空间推理任务要求模型结合多个视角来判断物体间物理邻近关系，避免只靠单视角局部线索。\n\n数据构建上，样本来自真实多视角场景数据集 DL3DV-10K，并做人工验证。全文强调 benchmark 的关键不是规模，而是控制变量。作者还做了几类诊断分析：把模型输出归因到简单聚合策略；测试图像顺序敏感性；去掉视觉输入看语言先验偏置；加入显式 reasoning 提示看是否能补足跨视角整合；以及增加视角数看性能是否随证据增加而改善。这些分析让 benchmark 不只是一个 leaderboard，而是能定位失败机制。","experiments":"作者评测了 12 个开源和闭源 VLM，在开放式生成协议下统一打分。最关键的结果出现在计数任务：当样例属于 complete overlap 时，各模型准确率大约在 45.5%–81.5%；subset overlap 为 26.7%–76.7%；而一旦进入必须做跨视角整合的 complementary views，准确率掉到 4.5%–50.0%。这个落差说明很多模型在“看多张图”时并没有稳定建立跨图实例对应。\n\n一致性任务更直接。整体准确率大致停留在 50% 左右，接近随机猜测，而且模型对 shared-region edit 和 view-specific edit 的反应相近，说明它们更多是在感知“有差异”，而不是判断“这种差异是否与同一场景相容”。这点很重要，因为它揭示了 VLM 缺的不是低层视觉比较，而是 visibility-aware reasoning。\n\n全文的附加分析也有信息量。作者发现不少计数预测可以被简单的 per-view aggregation 规则解释，说明模型经常走 shortcut。图像顺序敏感性实验表明，多图输入的融合并不稳定；no-image 或弱视觉输入设置下仍可能输出看似合理答案，暴露出语言模板偏置；显式要求模型逐步推理只能带来有限改善，说明问题不只是解码阶段没把 reasoning 写出来，而更可能是表征阶段没有形成可靠的 scene-level binding。增加更多视角也没有系统性解决问题，意味着瓶颈不只是证据不足，而是整合机制本身不足。","reading_guide":"泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，抓住 benchmark 的核心判断标准：题目是否真的要求 cross-view integration。然后重点看 In most UMMs, understanding features condition generation, but the reverse direction is rarely exploited. The authors do not add an external diffusion model or an auxiliary reconstruction objective. Instead, they ask whether intermediate states already produced by the model’s own diffusion transformer contain structural information—layout, boundaries, local geometry—that standard semantic visual encoders tend to underrepresent, and whether these states can be injected into multimodal reasoning without noticeably harming general understanding performance.","importance":"The main relevance to pretraining research is conceptual. That has implications for future joint objectives, shared latent spaces, and interface design between understanding and generation modules. 理解的能力缺口。论文用可控的程序化体素对象，系统定位：VLM 在哪些任务上能做局部判断、但在需要联合计数与一致性时失败，以及失败更像是视觉信息不可得还是“用不上”。","importance":"对基座预训练的直接贡献不在于提出新训练法，而在于把“评测信号”拆得更细：把 3D 同一对象上同时问 individual judgment（如总体积/颜色种类）与 exact answer（如每种颜色对应的块数分布），从而比较“会不会做局部判断”与“能否联合正确”。\n2) 一致性检查：例如模型先输出颜色分布（T5），再问“最常见颜色”（T7），看是否与自己给出的分布一致；并用“把模型自己的计数作为文本输入”来区分一致性是推理/读写问题还是视觉读出问题。\n3) ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-29T17:45:07Z","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2610_40576.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL"],"arxiv_url":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40576","source_url":null,"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是 信号有两种不同作用：一类是把训练轨迹拉到更可能成功的区域，解决“采不到正样本”；另一类是给局部 token 提供稠密监督，解决“即使有好轨迹，学生也未必学得会”。如果只做前者，teacher 轨迹可能偏离学生分布，难以模仿；如果只做后者，学生已经走偏时，局部蒸馏也救不回来。论文的核心问题就是：怎样把 teacher 纠错同时用于轨迹构造和 token 监督，让 RLVR 在 hard 提供了一个更清楚的设计框架：trajectory intervention 和 token supervision 是互补而不是替代关系。这个结论对后续做 reasoning mid-training、online distillation、以及 RL 与 imitation 混合目标的工作都有参考价值。贡献量级上，它不是改写 RLVR 基础算法，而是把 teacher correction 以在线、局部、可继续 rollout 的方式嵌进 RLVR 流程，并系统分析了介入位置、KL 形式和强度，属于训练 recipe 层面较扎实的一步。","technical_approach":"PIVOT 的做法可以概括为“在线局部纠错 + 继续采样 + 纠错段蒸馏”。训练时先由学生生成 rollout 前缀，在某个选定位置插入 teacher correction：teacher 不是整条代写，而是基于学生当前前缀给出一个纠正片段；随后学生从这个被纠正过的上下文继续生成后续 token。这样得到的 teacher-assisted trajectory 一方面更容易通向 verifier 可判对的终局，另一方面又保留了学生自己的续写分布，减少纯 teacher trajectory 带来的分布错位。\n\n优化目标有两部分。第一部分仍是 verifier 驱动的 更可控，因此知识迁移可能更平滑。\n\n论文探索了两种无需额外训练、也无需 calibration data 的弱化方式。第一是低比特量化，把原模型权重压到更低精度，制造系统性的表示损失。第二是 magnitude pruning，按权重幅值裁剪参数，直接降低容量。两者都很便宜，且不需要额外数据来拟合弱模型。作者强调这是 training-free weak model 难度，使标准继续区分不同回答对任务目标的满足程度，同时避免无差别加入新标准导致风格漂移。策略学习部分不只使用 scalar reward。对于满足诊断目标的 conditioned response，CoCA 把它视为 guided frontier，用作 privileged context 下的 token-level self-distillation；如果 conditioned response 也不可靠，则继续通过 conditioned rollout 的优化扩展能力边界。相比普通 rubric RL，它多了 criterion-level capability assessment；相比只演化 rubric 的方法，它把 rubric 变化和策略训练绑定在同一个反馈回路里。","experiments":"实验覆盖 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B 和 An ","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-10-27T19:13:01Z","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2610_37868.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL"],"arxiv_url":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37868","source_url":null,"summary":{"core_problem":"如何在不更新 的方法论文”。","technical_approach":"技术主线分三步。\n\n第一步是表示层。作者利用两个经验事实：归一化后 token 向量近似落在球面上；去掉位置信息后，自注意力对 token 集合是置换等变的。于是一个长度为 n 的句子被表示成球面上的经验测度 μ_n = (1/n)∑δ_{x_i}。语言不是 token 序列分布，而是这些测度的分布 P* ∈ P(P(S^d))。\n\n第二步是最大熵后验。先验 N 很简单：先采样句长 N，再独立均匀采样 token。然后在所有满足 E_P[Φ]=m 的分布里，求相对先验 N 的最小 KL 解。标准结果给出 Gibbs 形式 P^Φ ∝ exp(<V^Φ, Φ>) N，其中 V^Φ 是拉格朗日乘子。关键不在这个结论本身，而在于最后一个 token 的预测分布可以写成一个 score 驱动的形式，score 由统计量对“往句子里插入一个 token”这一扰动的变分导数 δΦ 决定。\n\n第三步是构造能导出 attention 的统计量。作者讨论了什么样的句级统计量能表达 token 间相互作用，并引入基于 Luce choice axiom 的构造，在最低关系阶上截断。这个截断很关键：它保留了最简单的 pairwise relational structure，同时避免更高阶相互作用带来的不可处理复杂度。这样得到的最后 token 选择律是 softmax 形式，其均值参数是 attention cross-moment。进一步，query-key 矩阵 Λ=Q^T K 出现在双线性相互作用项里，value 矩阵 V 则对应统计量读出的方向。换句话说，attention attention head 在特定 source-target 位置上的权重。作者先在原模型前向时缓存该 locale 的真实激活 a_c(x)，再用 LoRA 微调后的同一模型 M' 根据 (x, qc) 输出该信号的离散化或 verbalized 结果，并最小化相应损失。这样做的好处是：任务是自监督的，可以大规模生成训练样本；而且因为目标是模型自身的低层状态，ground truth 精确可得。\n\n论文的关键设计不只是训练一个 introspector，而是区分 endogenous 与 intervention 两种设置。endogenous 指信号自然由输入触发；intervention 指在前向过程中对目标内部信号做可控注入或修改。作者指出，很多已有设置如果只在 intervention 场景上训练和评估，模型可能通过检测“哪里被动过手脚”来回答，而不需要真正读取自然状态。为此，他们系统比较了普通 SFT 与 interventional training：在训练时加入对低层信号的干预样本，迫使模型面对“相关线索被打乱、只有目标信号本身可靠”的情况，从而减少 bypass。\n\n从机制分析看，作者进一步追踪了 introspection circuit。结果显示，处理 vocabulary to rely on. It reduces the question to a controlled bilingual modular-arithmetic world: two token-disjoint languages describe the same underlying structure, and the question is whether corresponding numbers become directly readable in the shared representation space rather than merely being represented in two separate but functionally equivalent coordinate systems.","importance":"The main value for pretraining research is conceptual and mechanistic. It argues that cross-lingual generalization can come from relational constraints in the shared world, not only from lexical overlap or parameter sharing. A shared answer subspace is not sufficient for entity-level alignment. This distinction matters for multilingual pretraining, especially in settings with deliberately reduced vocabulary overlap, language-specific tokenizers, or synthetic multilingual data where the relational structure of the corpus may determine what aligns.","technical_approach":"The authors adapt the modular-addition Transformer setting studied in grokking work into a bilingual setup. The two languages use disjoint tokens but refer to the same modulo-p arithmetic world. They vary the operations seen during training, such as addition alone, addition with subtraction, and max, and ask which operations make answer identities identifiable. The key hypothesis is relational identifiability: relations in a shared world can rule out alternative cross-lingual relabelings, making entity alignment more likely. Operationally, an answer is task-level identifiable if every relabeling that preserves the available tasks leaves that answer’s identity unchanged. The learned representations are then analyzed through answer-subspace overlap, direct cross-lingual readability, and downstream transfer.","experiments":"The main finding is that shared functional subspaces and entity alignment can come apart. With modular addition alone, the two languages learn closely overlapping answer subspaces that are relevant for solving the task, but corresponding numbers are not directly readable across languages. Adding subtraction makes zero identifiable and produces selective alignment. Adding the max operation yields broader alignment across numbers. The behavioral transfer experiments match the representation results: downstream properties involving task-identifiable and aligned answers transfer much better across languages. The setup builds on the classic modular-addition regime where a small Transformer trained on about 30% of input pairs can generalize to the remaining 70%, but the central measurement here is cross-lingual alignment rather than grokking itself.","reading_guide":"A 30–40 minute skim is enough. output-space perturbation、best-of-N、self-consistency 一类推理时机制，再讨论权重空间性质。它也说明，部分所谓权重扰动收益可能只是改变了解码分布，并通过验证集筛出了偏置有利的预测器。","technical_approach":"作者把 Neural Thickets 中的 RandOpt 统一成 Perturb-Select-Vote, PSV。流程很直接：采样 N 个被扰动的预测器，在少量任务验证集上打分，保留 top-K，再用多数投票聚合。原始 RandOpt 是在全参数空间加 Gaussian 噪声。作者逐步削弱扰动位置：从全模型扰动，到只扰动部分层，再到只扰动单个 decoder block，最后完全不改权重，只在输出 logits 上加入一个固定的随机 Gaussian bias。这个 bias 在自回归生成过程中保持不变，随后用 greedy decoding。这样每个 ensemble member 的差异来自 token 偏好的固定偏移，而不是网络内部计算变化。论文还给出一阶分析：小权重扰动对预测的主要影响可以近似看作其诱导的 logit shift。因此，全权重扰动在许多设置下并不比直接扰动 logits 更有解释优势。作者进一步拆解 sampling、selection、voting 三个因素：强基座模型上，温度调节采样加多数投票已经能接近全权重 PSV；弱模型上，验证集选择仍然重要，因为它能过滤掉不可靠成员。","experiments":"论文复现了 Gan & Isola 报告的现象，例如 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 在 Countdown 上从 10.8% 提升到 63.6% 这类大幅增益。关键结果是：不需要全权重扰动也能获得类似收益。扰动单个 decoder block 已经能恢复大部分提升；logit-only PSV 在多个推理任务上匹配或超过全权重扰动。一个具体数字是 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct 在 MATH-500 上，基线 accuracy 为 63.3%，全权重扰动 ensemble 达到 74.7%，而 logit-only PSV 达到 81.3%。PSV 设置沿用原工作的大规模随机成员采样，扰动预算 N 通常为 1000 到 5000，并用约 200 个目标任务样本做 selection set。论文还把方法扩展到视觉预训练模型的 domain shift 场景：全权重 PSV 需要扰动 backbone 并为每个成员训练 linear probe；logit-only PSV 只训练一个 probe，再扰动类别 Explorer–Builder–Verifier 三段式闭环，而且三者共享的是“证据”而不是隐式生成先验。Explorer–Builder 先在给定 URL、访问范围和预算下，对网站做浏览器侧采集。采集内容不只是静态页面，还包括：页面结构、计算样式、元素几何、截图、资源依赖，以及动作前后状态变化。论文特别强调同一 URL builder 可能在未观测区域做了推断，进入 targeted recapture，回源站补采特定页面状态或交互结果。修复后再次冻结并复验。这个“证据支持的修复 vs 证据不足的重采样”区分，是它和很多单轮生成式网页重建方法的主要差别。\n\n从研究取舍看，这套方案刻意避开了两条路：一条是 WebHarbor 式逐站人工工程，质量高但不扩展；另一条是纯生成式网站合成，扩展性强但源站对应关系弱。WebAnything 选的是浏览器可观测证据驱动的半约束重建，因此更适合做训练环境资产，而不是做开放域网页仿真。","experiments":"实验分三块：构建规模、环境质量、下游效用。\n\n构建规模上，资源池包含 244 个 website artifacts，覆盖 14 个 domain、53 个 在两者连线上插值。w_k=1 恢复原始策略，w_k=0 等于完全不信任 reasoning，w_k>1 则放大 reasoning 的影响。这样“信任”不再是保留/删除，而是可调强度。\n\n第二层是 Q-adaptive guidance。作者把每一步选择 w_k 看成一个有限动作集上的 MDP，但关键不是常规 bootstrap RL，而是利用系统的确定性直接测量 action
